create_better_networking.configuration.s: Uri l-ID tan-netwerk fil-wiri tal-enfasi tal-clipboard meta n-netwerk ma jkollux isem
create_better_networking.frequency.contr: Shift + klikk tax-xellug biex tikkopja; klikk tax-xellug biex tippejstja. Biex issemmi netwerk, żid entrata fil-clipboard li fiha biss #network: Link Series.
create_better_networking.frequency.empty: Ebda frekwenza salvata. Uża Shift + klikk tax-xellug fuq blokka konnessa biex tikkopja waħda.
create_better_networking.frequency.inact: Dak il-pannell tal-kejl tal-fabbrika mhuwiex attiv
create_better_networking.frequency.same: Dik il-blokka diġà tuża din il-frekwenza
